description: CI quality gate: lint job (pre-commit/ruff), security audit job (pip-audit), pytest+coverage job (gate 2%, path to 60%), evidence integrity job, Rust cargo check.
invariants: CI runs on push to main/clean-main and on PR to main
lint job runs pre-commit --all-files (includes ruff check, ruff-format, no-shell-true, no-hardcoded-paths, detect-private-key)
security-audit job runs pip-audit on requirements.txt
python-tests job runs pytest with --cov-fail-under=2 (current CI-achievable gate)
evidence-validate job runs `determinex evidence validate` read-only
Coverage gate path: 2% now → 60% target as hardware-dependent checks are mocked
uv.lock included in CI trigger paths (ensures lock stays in sync)
Coverage artifact uploaded on every run for trend tracking
coverage_gap_reason: Most scripts depend on T:/ drive, Ollama, Docker, GPU; these are excluded by 'not integration and not slow' markers in CI
